_comment: OPTIONAL model-PROVIDER profiles, read by api/src/providers.mjs. Each KEY is a profile name (lowercase/digits/dashes) the dashboard spawn dropdown, POST /api/agents/spawn and the MCP spawn_agent tool accept as `provider`; the agent then runs the UNCHANGED Claude-Code harness against that backend. `env` is OPAQUE — every NAME=value in it is injected verbatim into the agent's environment before `claude` starts, so any Anthropic-compatible backend works without a code change. `label` is what the dropdown shows. WITHOUT this file (or without a `provider` on the spawn) every agent runs exactly as before, on the Anthropic subscription. Copy to providers.json (GITIGNORED — it holds your API keys) and edit. Caveats, tier mapping and setup: docs/PROVIDERS.md.
